Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely declared the task complete and incorrectly answered “No,” claiming Ambroise Thomas is not an opera composer. This stems from misunderstanding that opéra comique and opéra lyrique are forms of opera; Thomas (e.g., Mignon, Hamlet) is indeed an opera composer. The Planner also failed to follow the process (verify via a specialist) before concluding.
